coverage.text: Fall 2026 Midterm 3 (Tue 10/27, 8–10pm, 45 points) covers content through Lecture 24: Efficiency.

scope.skipText: Out of scope for Midterm 3 (staff say skip)
scope.note: Exams and skips follow the staff’s Midterm 3 index (Ed #1237): whole past Midterm 2 exams, skipping parts that mutate linked lists or trees, use repr, or use orders of growth. Staff named no Midterm 3 question picks; the CSM picks are kept from this site’s earlier data, but their source couldn’t be found on Ed.

timed.intro: Each exam draws problems at random from modified versions of every problem the course staff recommend for Midterm 3 practice. Names, numbers, and requirements are changed, so you have to work out each answer rather than remember it.
